purpose: CodeMirror 6 edits the Code block element; Desegnos has no page source editor
scope: Editor UI only; bundled offline; no native capabilities, remote scripts, telemetry or generated-site runtime imports. Package installation used --ignore-scripts.
provenance: Official @codemirror and @lezer package scopes and their upstream repositories; direct versions exact-pinned and all resolved versions/integrities frozen in pnpm-lock.yaml. GitHub archives link to active code.haverbeke.berlin repositories.
